runtime.note: Box64 is not downloaded. It ships inside the APK as jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libbox64.so and is executed from nativeLibraryDir, the only app-owned path Android API 29+ allows exec() from. Everything listed below is loaded by Box64's own ELF loader out of app data and therefore never needs an exec bit.

artifacts.license: Upstream distro licenses of the bundled glibc/libstdc++ libraries
artifacts.notes: Official Box64 v0.4.2 release asset. Supplies the x86_64 glibc and libstdc++ guest libraries bedrock_server links against. Extracted to files/bds-runtime/x86lib and exposed through BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
x86_64 build on purpose: it runs through Box64. The official aarch64 playit binary is glibc-linked and cannot run on Android bionic.

unavailable.box64: No upstream standalone Android ARM64 executable is published. It must be built by .github/workflows/runtime-build.yml, verified on a device, and placed in app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libbox64.so before building the APK.
unavailable.bds: Official Mojang Linux download is x86_64 and must be fetched after the user accepts Mojang terms, with a version-specific SHA-256 supplied from a trusted source.

removed.ubuntu-22.04-arm64-rootfs: Dropped. It was an ARM64 host userspace, useless for an x86_64 guest, and needed PRoot to be reachable at all.
removed.proot: Dropped. Android API 29+ forbids exec() from app data, so a downloaded PRoot binary could never be launched, and PRoot's ptrace path is unreliable under Android seccomp.
removed.playit-linux-aarch64: Dropped. glibc-linked ARM64 binary; unusable on bionic and unexecutable from app data.
